title: OKForest tree settings
description: Settings for an OKF tree in .okforest/tree.yaml: who is accountable for it and who looks after it. An OKForest convention, not part of OKF. Docs: https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/
markdownDescription: Settings for an OKF tree in `.okforest/tree.yaml`: who is accountable for it and who looks after it. An OKForest convention, not part of OKF. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/)

owner.description: Required. The one person accountable for the tree's accuracy and relevance; never a group. One person, as user:<id> (usually an email address).
owner.markdownDescription: Required. The one person accountable for the tree's accuracy and relevance; never a group. One person, as `user:<id>` (usually an email address). [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#owner)

backup_owner.description: Acts for the Owner during absences; accountability stays with the Owner. One person, as user:<id> (usually an email address).
backup_owner.markdownDescription: Acts for the Owner during absences; accountability stays with the Owner. One person, as `user:<id>` (usually an email address). [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#backup_owner)

stewards.description: The people who keep the tree current: they review and approve changes. Each entry is user: <id> or group: <name>; groups are recommended.
stewards.markdownDescription: The people who keep the tree current: they review and approve changes. Each entry is `user: <id>` or `group: <name>`; groups are recommended. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#stewards)

user.description: A person, by the ID your directory knows (usually an email address).

tree.description: The tree's short name, independent of the repository's name.
tree.markdownDescription: The tree's short name, independent of the repository's name. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#tree)

ignore.description: Globs, relative to the tree root, of markdown files that are not concepts. * matches within a folder name, ** across folders, ? one character; a trailing / matches a whole folder.
ignore.markdownDescription: Globs, relative to the tree root, of markdown files that are not concepts. `*` matches within a folder name, `**` across folders, `?` one character; a trailing `/` matches a whole folder. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#files-that-are-not-concepts)

sensitivity_default.description: The sensitivity of the tree's content when a concept doesn't say. Reserved for access control.
sensitivity_default.markdownDescription: The sensitivity of the tree's content when a concept doesn't say. Reserved for access control. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#sensitivity_default)

standards.description: Which version of the organization's standards applies. Reserved for organization standards.
standards.markdownDescription: Which version of the organization's standards applies. Reserved for organization standards. [Docs](https://www.okforest.ai/docs/tree-settings/#standards)
